panel-min-width.$description: New token (2026-10-31), added for NavigationMenu's panel — the least width a panel takes, so a panel holding one short group of links still reads as a panel under its item and not a thin sliver. No primitive scale holds it (the spacing scale tops out at 8rem), and `menu.min-width` caps a list of actions, not a panel of grouped links.

panel-max-width.$description: New token (2026-10-31), added for NavigationMenu's panel — the most width a panel takes, so a panel of several columns of grouped links, descriptions and a featured block fits without running across a wide screen. A content measure with no home on any primitive scale; `menu.max-width` and `popover.max-width` (24rem) cap a list and a small popover, a different thing.
